conclusion_the_comparison_could_support: M1 route (acts through M1 in OPC)
condition: Dose ladder placed against the potency in the assay used, not the Ki

why_it_matters: A ladder spanning roughly 1 nM to 1 uM covers the OPC EC50 plus the binding Ki; the immunopanned-mouse and EpiSC-derived preparations have no measured EC50 for any M1-selective reagent

condition: Dose ladder against EBP potency in OPCs
value_or_state_and_source: TASIN-1 enhanced MBP+ at 100 nM (EpiSC OPC, PMID 30046109); CW3388 near-maximal at 110 nM, lowest dose tested (PMID 30773481); CW9956/CW9009 EC50 mid-nanomolar; enzymatic 10 uM single points only

condition: Cross-activity ceilings stated in the assay of the comparison

status: MEASURED single points; PIPE-307 EBP NOT_MEASURED_IN_SOURCE

condition: M1 tone present in the preparation
value_or_state_and_source: ACh in primary-rat OPC conditioned medium 12 nM; exogenous ACh IC50 57.7 nM (PMID 39083422). No ACh measurement for EpiSC-derived OPCs (Hubler text) or immunopanned mouse OPCs (Mei text)
status: MEASURED rat; NOT_MEASURED_IN_SOURCE for the other two
why_it_matters: An antagonist is inert without tone; absence of PIPE-307 effect in a preparation with no tone would not exclude an M1 route; an ACh/carbachol add-back arm and a tone measurement are the gate

condition: Preparation identity (three OPC systems) held constant
value_or_state_and_source: EpiSC-derived (mouse, 129 lines; Hubler/Allimuthu), primary rat (PIPE-307; cultures conditioned 3 d), immunopanned mouse 95% pure (Mei; knockouts)
why_it_matters: Differences in ligand tone, medium (B27, N2, noggin, NT3, cAMP, IGF-1 in Hubler; PDGF removal in PIPE-307) and species mean a contrast read in one system does not transfer to another

value_or_state_and_source: GC/MS zymostenol, zymosterol up; cholesterol, desmosterol down at 24 h (n = 2 wells) in Hubler; 14-dehydrozymostenol for TM7SF2, lanosterol for CYP51
why_it_matters: Target engagement for the EBP arm and an off-target check for the PIPE-307 arm (a sterol profile at the dose used) is a readout at the sterol level, separate from MBP+ share

condition: MBP+ share and segment-length index kept as separate levels
value_or_state_and_source: MBP+ share: EpiSC (Hubler/Allimuthu; 72 h, >1,000 cells per well) and rat OPC (PIPE-307 72 h); segment-length (MBP/Tuj1 per oligodendrocyte) in rat cortical culture (PMID 39083422); microfiber MBP area in EpiSC (PMID 30773481)
why_it_matters: A marker count does not prove function; an index per cell is not a count of axons myelinated; levels are not pooled

value_or_state_and_source: Wwox-null (or WWOX-DEE class genotype) OPCs on wild-type neurons and wild-type OPCs on Wwox-null neurons, each arm with each reagent class; reverse pairing first (SCI50 audit)
why_it_matters: Without the crossing, a gap that persists cannot be attributed to neurons rather than to OPC-intrinsic block

value_or_state_and_source: Chrm1-null OPCs differentiate about 4-5 fold more than WT (Mei Fig 4c about 16 v 4 MBP+ cells per field; text five-fold) and drug effect is abolished
why_it_matters: The null baseline occludes: null versus null plus any drug is a floor/ceiling contrast, interpretable only when positive. A conditional or acute M1 block against a null baseline is not a clean test

value_or_state_and_source: EpiSC-derived OPCs with Cas9 and two guides against EBP: reduced transcript, zymostenol up, enhanced formation (Hubler, 8 wells, p = 0.0009 in legend)
why_it_matters: A genetic EBP arm exists in one OPC system (not rat or immunopanned mouse); it is a pooled CRISPR, not a germline null, so reagent specificity can be tested by sgEBP plus an M1 reagent without a second EBP inhibitor

condition: Controls: positive, vehicle, sterol pathway, agonist add-back

why_it_matters: Hubler found non-additivity at a maximal ketoconazole dose; T3 additive with sterol-route enhancers: the arm set needs submaximal doses and a headroom arm

value_or_state_and_source: 1 uM (Hubler legend 1 uM; 2 uM in combination tests; PIPE-307 human slice 1 uM; M1 CHO assay 1 uM) and benztropine 2 uM in Hubler
